facts.fact: Minister Mahuna Akplogan announced on 18 November 2026 that the 'J'aime ma langue' AI project, which has collected 1,000 hours of language data in Fon, Dendi, Bariba and Yoruba, is now open source.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transformation and Innovation

note: No users of the opened data are named or counted, so nothing on sharing.
